# freshdesk_scenario_automations (Data Source)

Every scenario automation on the helpdesk. Scenarios are read-only through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_scenario_automations" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `scenario_automations`.
- `scenario_automations` (Attributes List) Every scenario automation the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scenario_automations))

<a id="nestedatt--scenario_automations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scenario_automations`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (String) Actions the scenario applies, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the scenario was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the scenario.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the scenario automation.
- `name` (String) Name of the scenario.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether the scenario is private to its owner.
- `updated_at` (String) When the scenario was last changed (RFC 3339).
